name: ltl-persistence
description: Token-lean, compaction-surviving persistence for Claude Code — set up and maintain a 'resume-here' handoff, an optional user-defined standing-rules file, and opt-in hooks (PreCompact points the compaction summary at the exact handoff; SessionStart re-injects it after a compact or resume; Stop blocks the end of a turn while a changed project's handoff is missing or stale), all wired into the native auto-loaded layer (CLAUDE.md / memory). Improves cross-session memory at minimum token cost; ships zero rules of its own.
